scoring_justification: Occupancies and charge transfer are recomputed from raw PDOS CSV using trapezoidal integration; compared against paper-reported values (s occupancy ~2.1, net charge transfer ~0.6) with tolerances that absorb DFT-implementation spread.

outputs.description: Raw projected density of states for the central Al atom. The Fermi level must be at energy=0. The checker computes orbital occupancies by integrating below the Fermi level and compares to paper-derived tolerances.

items.s_occupancy: float (number of 3s electrons below Fermi level)
items.net_charge_transfer: float (electrons lost from the contact site, positive)

outputs.description: Derived orbital occupancies and net charge transfer. The checker uses its own recomputation from pdos.csv to verify self-consistency and, indirectly, the suppression of sp hybridization.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes occupancies from pdos.csv using numerical integration and tolerances derived from the paper's reported quantities (3s occupancy ~70%, charge transfer ~0.6 e). The results.json values serve as a cross-check to ensure the agent performed the analysis.
